$Comment: Beating a boss fight run by the game's own encounter scripts. Target is the encounter SCRIPT id (the file name under Server/EncounterManager), never the boss creature's id: a fight that swaps roles between phases has no one creature id, so a step naming the script holds through every phase. Fires once per credited participant when the boss falls; Qualifier is the run's difficulty label (from the spawn call or the binding row's Progression.Difficulty) and Amount is 1 per fight. A step reads {"Kind": "ENCOUNTER_DEFEATED", "Target": "Zc_Encounter_Example", "Amount": 1}; leave Target empty to count any boss. A participant whose share fell under the fight's MinShare is not credited here and counts under ENCOUNTER_ATTEMPT instead. A base-game boss with no fight of its own that an encounter rule names (Server/ZiggfreedCommon/EncounterRules) also counts here: its kill credits the killer alone, once, with Target the creature's role id (Goblin_Feastmaster, Bear_Voidtaken, Skeleton_Elite_Phase_2) and no Qualifier.
